=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1815-1816 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The ci.yml base-gate jq returns `pending` only when `$base_runs[0].status != "completed"`. Push and scheduled runs use separate concurrency groups (`ci-push-<ref>` and `ci-schedule-<ref>`), so a newer delta push that has completed can sit at index 0 while an older scheduled full run is still running. The gate then ignores the in-flight run and takes its verdict from completed runs only.
  WHY: If the completed delta push is green, the gate reads the base as green, logs `skip reason=pr_specific_failure`, and skips triage for the PR failure even though the scheduled full run may still fail, which undermines issue Goal 6. Reviewers disagreed on severity: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT with confidence 3 and called the impact bounded by heal intake and red-wins; minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said MAJOR with confidence 4. The highest (MAJOR, shown as high) is used. Suggested fix: `elif any($base_runs[]; .status != "completed") then "pending"`.
- README.md:191 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` row describes the green-clears-red rule (`run_started_at`, else `created_at`) without the new re-run exception. In all four readers, a green run with `run_attempt > 1` now counts from `created_at`. The readers are `scripts/ci_main_delta.sh` (verdict jq), `scripts/check_failure_triage.sh` (base-gate jq), `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` (`base_red_wins_jq`) and `scripts/check_triage_resolution.py` (`_run_start`).
  WHY: The documentation no longer matches the code, though nothing breaks at runtime. Operators would expect a green re-run that started after a red run finished to clear `base_red`, but the code does not let it. All four reviewers rated it NIT.
- agents.d/10156-main-push-delta-ci.md:4-7 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fragment states the red-wins rule as "`run_started_at`, else `created_at`, >= its `updated_at`" (line 4), plus the bullet at line 7 and the `scripts/ci_main_delta.sh select` bullet, with no mention of the `run_attempt > 1` re-run exception.
  WHY: The fragment documents a contractual log prefix (`LOG_PREFIX.name=CI_MAIN_DELTA`) and folds into `agents.md`, so readers would not predict the re-run behaviour. This is documentation drift only, rated NIT.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:151 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `scripts/ci_main_delta.sh` entry ("...runs the full suite (`base_red`) while a red run has no green run started after it finished (one runs read)...") omits the re-run exception: runs with `run_attempt > 1` count from `created_at` and never clear red.
  WHY: An inventory reader would predict the wrong outcome for green runs with `run_attempt > 1`. Documentation drift only, rated NIT.
- changelog.d/10156-main-push-delta-ci.md:lead paragraph | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The lead paragraph ("Every push to `main` used to run the full CI suite...") does not mention the re-run exception added in the last run.
  WHY: Operators would expect any green re-run that starts after the red run finished to clear `base_red`, which the code no longer allows. Nothing breaks at runtime; rated NIT.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:560 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runs read filters `status=completed` server-side, so an in-progress scheduled full run never appears in `base_runs`. A green delta push that has completed becomes `base_runs[0]`, and the evidence check (lines 607-620) passes.
  WHY: Triage resolution can mark issues resolved against a base that is not yet settled while a scheduled full run is still running. This is the same overlap class as the check_failure_triage.sh finding but with weaker impact, since a failed scheduled run gets its own triage issue; rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:5054-5055 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment `# runs once, takes the head of the newest successful push or scheduled run as the base` is stale. It predates the red-wins rule and has been declined for three editor rounds with the reason "no workflow edits this run".
  WHY: The comment still describes the old rule, and nothing breaks at runtime. This was raised inside z-ai_glm-5_3-flash's README.md finding, rated NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:line 1816, `elif $base_runs[0].status != "completed" then "pending"` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The base gate returns `pending` only when the newest-created push or schedule run is in progress. A delta push created after a scheduled full run (separate group `ci-schedule-<ref>`) can finish first and sit at index 0, so the in-flight full run is never considered.
  WHY: With the scheduled run created at 22:30 and still running, and a green delta push created at 22:35 and completed, the gate reads `success <push id>` and logs `skip reason=pr_specific_failure`. Impact is bounded: heal intake picks up the red scheduled run, and red-wins applies to later reads. The issue predates the last autofix run. Hardening suggestion: replace with `any($base_runs[]; (.status // "") != "completed")`, 1 line changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- README.md:line 191 (also agents.d/10156-main-push-delta-ci.md line 4 and line 7) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README row and the agents.d fragment still state the old rule. The last autofix run added the re-run exception (`run_attempt` > 1 counts from `created_at`) to scripts/ci_main_delta.sh line 233, scripts/check_failure_triage.sh line 1816, scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh `base_red_wins_jq`, and scripts/check_triage_resolution.py `_run_start` lines 591-598.
  WHY: The docs no longer match the contract, though nothing breaks at runtime. Operators would expect a re-run attempt to clear `base_red`. The fix is about one clause in each doc.
- Task completeness: none. Reviewer verified Goals 1-7. "No promotion starts without a full run from the same day" is a Rollout watch item, not a gap. The re-run jq and Python logic was checked and no defects were found.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1815-1816 (the `elif $base_runs[0].status != "completed" then "pending"` clause) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `runs?branch=<base>&per_page=10` listing includes in-progress runs, but `pending` checks only `$base_runs[0]`. An older scheduled run that is still in progress is excluded from `$done`, and the gate emits the green conclusion of the newer push that has completed.
  WHY: `CHECK_TRIAGE` logs `skip reason=pr_specific_failure base=main base_conclusion=success` while the full suite is still running, which violates Goal 6. Hardening suggestion: `elif any($base_runs[]; .status != "completed") then "pending"`, 1 line changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:560 (`runs_path = f"repos/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/runs?branch={branch_query}&status=completed&per_page=20"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3

  WHY: Resolution can be issued against a base that is not yet settled. Same overlap class as the triage finding, with weaker impact.

The stale comment at .github/workflows/ci.yml:5054-5055 is also still out of date, and was declined for three editor rounds.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but readers would expect a green `run_attempt: 2` run to clear `base_red`, and the code never lets it.
